column1: # The X50 recipe (g0111 X50 Ultra, g0100 X50 Ultra Max): steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS.
# Base: the published Z9X 1.0.9 image; every kept file is the base's byte for byte with its owner, mode, label and
# capability. What changes and why: devices/g0111/README.md; verify_tree_x50.py proves exactly that and nothing else.
# Flags: test (tN) or pub (a release version), stage (--stage-only), image (--image-only).
# the HAL app's calls against the allow lists of verify_tree_x50.py, with the model's own platform certificate
# the base, the stock model props of the dump, the X50 kernel (the base's ART boot image needs userfaultfd)
# the tree: root copy, removals, the platform set on the model's keys, otacerts without a certificate, props
# network adb (test images only), the X50 blobs reader with the eye-protection drawer and its placeholders
# the eye-follow fail-safe (persistent system app), the power keys and their framework RRO
# Lumen Home and the HDMI input of this tree over the base's (their oat files were compiled for the base APKs)
# install from a DSU try: the app, its init rc and its root script
# the projector menu with the remote pairing
# the staged tree against the base
# the image: 4 KiB blocks, lz4hc, no inline data (erofs_kcheck.py), one time for every file, a UUID from TAG,
# the build id and the base sha256
# group_oem_a holds 4613734400 bytes; the system stays under 2.5 GB with room for z9x_blobs and z9x_gapps
